 Oral Order
3 07-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P for the State.

2. The petitioner has preferred this application for grant of regular bail in connection with Complaint Case No. C1/131/2023 dated 16.06.2023 registered for the offence/s punishable u/ss 323, 341, 498A, 494, 504 read with section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Earlier the petitioner was granted provisional bail vide order dated 17.09.2025 and learned counsel for the petitioner seeks confirmation of the provisional bail granted to the petitioner.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.67295 of 2025(3) dt.07-11-2025 4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
The petitioner is the husband of the complainant.
The petitioner neither demanded any dowry nor tortured the complainant.
There is general and omnibus allegation against the petitioner.
The petitioner has clean antecedent as stated in para 3 of the bail petition.
